# Positioned text groups

`positioned-runs.pdf` contains two headings followed by `abc`, `def`, `ghi`,
`jkl`, `mno`, `pqr`, `stu`, `vwx`, `yz`. Every group has an independent
`BT / Tm / Tj / ET` sequence (11 of each including the headings).

Generated with pdf-lib on a 600 × 800 page: headings at (40, 760) and (40, 730),
12pt; group i at (40 + 42 × i, 700), also 12pt. The headings are `Heading one`
and `Heading two`. The groups follow source order, unlike the reverse-order
fixture generated by the browser regression script.

PDF extraction emits a source space between these positioned groups. Text
layout omits the whitespace-only source items and inserts its own display
spacing. Therefore `mno pqr stu v` has canonical page-1 offsets [38, 51),
not the offsets of the unspaced alphabet. A short selection crosses four
independent positioning operations and must remain one saved range.

Run `POSITIONED=1 WEBBASE_BROWSER_URL='http://127.0.0.1:6229/?demo=1' node
scripts/check-webbase-pdf-draft.mjs` from the reader checkout. The script imports
this exact PDF through WebBase's real document and persistence path.
